task.description:
Implement the following four SHOULD requirements for the Process Designer canvas on branch feature/WF02-f2b-shoulds-20260529:

1. **PD-UI-16 — CEL expression editor**: Replace the existing ConditionDialog textarea with a code editor (CodeMirror) with CEL syntax highlighting and bracket matching. Install @codemirror/lang-cel or use a generic CodeMirror setup for CEL. Surface server-side syntax errors inline below the field.

2. **PD-UI-17 — Canvas minimap & zoom**: Add <MiniMap /> and <Controls /> from @xyflow/react to ProcessCanvas. Ensure they are positioned correctly and toggleable.

3. **PD-UI-18 — Auto-layout**: Add a 'Re-layout' button near the canvas toolbar. Implement Dagre-based layout (install dagre and @types/dagre). Apply layout to all nodes when clicked with smooth transitions.

4. **PD-UI-19 — Undo/redo**: Implement an undo/redo history stack for all canvas operations. Use Zustand or React state to track past/present/future states. Support Ctrl+Z (undo) and Ctrl+Y (redo) keyboard shortcuts.
acceptance_criteria: npm run test exits 0 (pure unit tests)
All existing E2E tests still pass (npx playwright test)
PD-UI-16: ConditionDialog uses CodeMirror with CEL highlighting
PD-UI-17: MiniMap and Controls visible on canvas
PD-UI-19: Ctrl+Z undoes last canvas operation, Ctrl+Y redoes
